author: David Leisering
title: Tomoyuki Sugano outduels Paul Skenes in win on Saturday
desc: Tomoyuki Sugano allowed one run on four hits, did not walk a batter, and struck out five as he helped the Rockies to a 2-1 win over Paul Skenes and the Pirates on Saturday.
impact: Sugano allowed a home run to Spencer Horwitz to open the game, but settled in nicely after that as he made quick work of the Pittsburgh lineup. The righthander allowed all four hits in the first 10 batters, but retired the final 12 hitters he faced after Horwitz singled to lead off the third.  It was the first time since April 29 that he allowed one run or fewer in a game and he improved to 4-0 in four starts this month, despite a 5.14 ERA in 21 innings. Sugano will take on the Twins, in Minnesota, in his next scheduled start on Friday.

author: David Leisering
title: Paul Skenes let down by Pirates' offense again Saturday
desc: Paul Skenes allowed two runs on four hits, walked two, and struck out eight across six innings on Saturday. However, the Pirates' offense let him down again as Pittsburgh dropped a 2-1 decision in Colorado.
impact: Skenes saw his winless streak hit seven straight starts on Saturday as he dropped to 0-5 since his last victory on May 12 against the Rockies. Over his last five outings, Skenes is 0-3 with a 2.57 ERA and a 42:9 K:BB ratio in 28 innings. His seven losses on the year is tied for third-most in the National League despite owning the league's ninth-best ERA (2.86) and posting the third-most strikeouts (107). He'll look to get back in the win column on Friday in a home start against the Reds.

author: David Leisering
title: Spencer Horwitz provides lone Pirates' run in loss to Rockies
desc: Spencer Horwitz led off Saturday's game with a home run and finished with two hits in four at bats as the Pirates suffered a 2-1 loss to the Rockies.
impact: Horwitz opened the game with a 434-foot blast into the right field seats off of Colorado starter Tomoyuki Sugano to get the Pirates on the board. That, however, would be the only run Pittsburgh scored on the night. Horwitz is having himself a fine season, batting .281 with 10 home runs and 33 RBI while hitting, primarily, in the leadoff spot. His career-best in home runs is 12 as a member of the Blue Jays in 2024, so he could be on his way to a 20-home run campaign for the first time in his career.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Kyle Manzardo drives in three as Guardians cruise past Astros
desc: Kyle Manzardo went 2-for-4 in an 8-1 win over the Astros on Saturday with a home run, one run scored, three RBI, and two strikeouts.
impact: After Saturday's win over Houston, Manzardo is slashing .238/.328/.413 with nine home runs, 26 RBI, 26 runs scored, a 10.2 percent walk rate, and a 32.3 percent strikeout rate across 67 games. He's hitting .298 with four homers and nine RBI in his past 15 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jasson Dominguez chips in two hits, swipes base in loss
desc: Jasson Dominguez went 2-for-3 in a loss to the Reds with one stolen base.
impact: Dominguez has heated back up at the plate since being called back up, picking up hits in five of his last six contests. The 23-year-old continues to frustrate fantasy managers with his inconsistent bat, slashing .241 with two home runs, five RBI, six runs scored, and one stolen base across 15 games.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Travis Bazzana torches Astros with two-homer, five-RBI day
desc: Travis Bazzana went 4-for-4 in Saturday's 8-1 win over the Astros with two home runs, three runs scored and five RBI.
impact: Bazzana started off with a leadoff homer, then followed that up with a three-run shot in the fifth inning. Through 46 games, he's batting .274 with seven homers, 23 RBI, 22 runs scored, and 11 stolen bases while posting a .365 wOBA and .310 BABIP. Bazzana has been red hot of late, hitting .375 with three homers and six RBI in his past seven games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Anthony Volpe chips in a hit and a steal in lopsided loss
desc: Anthony Volpe went 1-for-3 in a loss to the Reds with a walk and one stolen base.
impact: Volpe has heated up at the plate, recording hits in seven of his last eight contests. The infielder has offered manager Aaron Boone one of the more steady options when in the Yankees lineup, slashing .267 with one home run, six stolen bases, 16 runs scored, and 13 RBI through 27 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jose Caballero swipes base in loss to Reds
desc: Jose Caballero went 0-for-3 in a loss to the Reds with a walk, one RBI, and one stolen base.
impact: Caballero has heated back up, reaching base in seven of his last eight contests. The 29-year-old remains one of the more streaky options in the Yankees lineup for manager Aaron Boone, batting .261 with seven home runs, 26 RBI, 28 runs scored, and 16 stolen bases across 63 games.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Joey Cantillo carves up Astros over eight in 8-1 win
desc: Joey Cantillo allowed one earned run on four hits and one walk while striking out nine over eight innings in Saturday's 8-1 win over the Astros.
impact: Cantillo was efficient enough to make 98 pitches feel like a full day's work for Houston in what goes down as his best start of the season. He now owns a 4.05 ERA and 1.40 WHIP with a 6-3 record through 16 starts this season. Cantillo will be back on the mound to take on the Mariners on Friday.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Victor Caratini cashes in big as Twins torch D-backs
desc: Victor Caratini went 3-for-5 in a 16-8 win over the Diamondbacks on Saturday with a double, three runs scored, three RBI, a walk, and two strikeouts.
impact: Caratini did the heavy lifting in a lopsided win, padding the box score without needing to leave the yard. After Saturday's win over Arizona, Caratini is batting .241 with five home runs, 29 RBI, 17 runs scored, a .311 wOBA, and a .272 BABIP across 56 games. He's been on fire over his past 15 games, hitting .396 with three homers and 11 RBI.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Paul Goldschmidt goes deep in loss to Reds
desc: Paul Goldschmidt went 1-for-5 in a loss to the Reds with a solo home run.
impact: Goldschmidt continues a productive stretch at the plate, driving in runs in eight of his last 12 contests. The veteran continues to capitalize on increased playing time in a Yankees lineup without Giancarlo Stanton and Aaron Judge, batting .291 with 12 home runs, 37 RBI, 27 runs scored, and one stolen base across 50 games.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Ryan Kreidler drives in four as Twins torch D-backs 16-8
desc: Ryan Kreidler went 3-for-4 in a 16-8 win over the Diamondbacks on Saturday with a triple, two runs scored, four RBI, and a walk.
impact: Kreidler kept cashing checks in a lopsided win, making the bottom of the order look like a middle-of-the-lineup problem for Arizona. After Saturday's win, Kreidler is slashing .270/365/.527 through 35 games with four home runs, 18 RBI, and a .118 walk rate.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Luke Keaschall racks up three hits in 16-8 rout
desc: Luke Keaschall did his part in the Twins' track meet, even if the lack of extra-base pop is starting to look like a feature.
impact: Keaschall went 3-for-6 in a 16-8 win over the Diamondbacks on Saturday with three runs scored. After Saturday's win, Keaschall is slashing .259/.340/.337 with two home runs, 24 RBI, 38 runs scored, and 11 stolen bases across 72 games. Keaschall has been hot of late, hitting .400 over his past seven games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Will Warren victim of bad luck in loss to Reds
desc: Will Warren allowed six (two earned) runs on eight hits and two walks while striking out eight over 5 2/3 innings in Saturday's loss to the Reds.
impact: Warren has struggled to miss opposing bats of late, allowing three or more runs in four of his last six trips to the mound. The right-hander has been one of the more inconsistent arms as part of a deep Yankees starting staff for manager Aaron Boone, posting a 3.45 ERA and 1.33 WHIP with a 7-2 record and 9.7 K/9 ratio through 15 starts.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Brooks Lee fuels Twins rout with four-hit afternoon
desc: Brooks Lee went 4-for-6 with a double, a triple, three runs scored, and two RBI in a 16-8 win over the Diamondbacks.
impact: Lee finished just a homer shy of hitting for the cycle. After Saturday's win, Lee is batting .245 with 12 homers, 44 RBI, 36 runs scored, and three stolen bases across 74 games. Lee is heating up at the plate, hitting .308 with one homer and five RBI over his past seven games.
